text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day in October, a bizarre<n>spectacle unfolds at
the Tokyo<n>Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! There's so many<n>people, you'd think
this was a G1<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the lineup, no one would<n>blame you for
assuming it was.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka is competing today.<n>She's had a
string of victories lately.

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, there's the famed<n>Beast—Grass
Wonder—as well as El<n>Condor Pasa, hailed as being
the<n>strongest runner in the classic year...

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to think I get to watch such an<n>exciting race! I
was right to make it<n>my mission to follow these
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka, Grass, and El are all pals of<n>mine!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The race kicks off under the watchful<n>gaze of the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Try as she might, Grass Wonder is<n>struggling to
make any ground!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa is coming in from<n>behind, but she
can't close the gap!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Which leaves Silence Suzuka,<n>refusing to relinquish
the lead all the<n>way to the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
She held the lead throughout the<n>whole race yet
again...

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka's races are all so<n>memorable—she
knows how to keep<n>the crowd hooked.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even though she was already so far<n>ahead, she
still put on that extra burst<n>at the end...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There's just somethin' about the<n>way Suzuka
runs... Wonder what it<n>is?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This must be Silence Suzuka's<n>newfound style of
running.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her unique approach captivates the<n>hearts of those
who witness it.
